# Recreation Prompt

Recreate **Cozy Craft Pocket Forge**, a portrait-first browser voxel sandbox inspired by Minecraft-like block creativity. Preserve the core mechanics: a Three.js 8×8 editable block island, orbit drag camera, hotbar tool/material selection, tap/click raycast interaction, pickaxe removal, adjacent face placement when empty, reset regeneration, particles, feedback chips, and mobile-safe start flow. Present the game as a cozy pocket sky biome where the player gathers and places infinite creative materials, explores by rotating the island, and sets their own maker goals. Use procedural browser-native visual identity: blocky sun, drifting clouds, hills, ore glints, chunky material UI, raised mobile cards, pixel counters, and playful readable typography.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint — Cozy Craft Pocket Forge

## Source truth
The preserved source is a browser-native Three.js voxel sandbox. It boots to a start overlay, creates an 8×8 island chunk with stone/dirt/grass layers and a tree, lets the player orbit the camera by dragging, select a hotbar tool, tap/click a block to remove it with the pickaxe, or tap a block face with a material selected to place a new cube adjacent to that face. Reset regenerates the starter island. Feedback is shown through short chips, particles, GIF accents, and optional user-gesture-safe audio.

## Protected mechanics
- Start/play flow and reset flow.
- Orbit drag, zoom limits, no pan, mobile tap target behavior.
- Raycast block hit detection against voxel meshes.
- Pickaxe removes the selected block.
- Material tools place one block adjacent to the tapped face when the target space is empty.
- Existing occupancy check and blocked-action feedback.
- Regenerated island structure: bounded 8×8 footprint, layered stone/dirt/grass, tree/prop blocks.
- Animation loop, particles, and responsive resize.

## Transformable surfaces
Title, HUD wording, portrait layout polish, palette, procedural textures, background scene ownership, start overlay, stats labels, feedback copy, fonts, decorative GIF placement, audio tone, and world semantics are safe to transform because they do not change placement/removal rules.

## Remix target
A portrait-first cozy Minecraft-like maker island called **Cozy Craft Pocket Forge**. The focal identity is the player's pocket sky biome: a tiny handmade chunk that invites gathering, placing, exploring from orbit, and player-driven goals. The world uses blocky sun/cloud/hill/ore motifs, chunky UI cards, material previews, and readable mobile hotbar controls.
